$comment: Every setting of Explorer Extras, declared once. build.py writes the Windhawk settings block and the C++ settings table from it. See SPEC-settings-shell.md.

settings.name: Enabled
settings.description: Adds the Columns entry to the View menu. Off removes it.

settings.name: Open new windows in Columns
settings.description: When the last layout you chose was Columns, a new Explorer window opens in Columns too. Choosing any other layout in the View menu turns this off.

settings.name: Desktop column shows only real items
settings.description: Hides the virtual items of the Desktop column (This PC, Recycle Bin, Control Panel, Libraries and so on) and keeps the files, folders and shortcuts that are on the Desktop.

settings.name: Mark cloud, network and device items
settings.description: A small glyph at the end of a row for a cloud file that is not downloaded, an item on a network location, or an item on a phone or camera.

settings.name: Remember sort and group per folder
settings.description: Each column keeps its own sort and group, taken from Explorer's view of that folder, and shows it again next time. When off, all columns share the sort of the first folder.

settings.name: Remember column width per folder
settings.description: A column dragged to a width reopens at that width the next time the folder is shown.

settings.name: Remember Columns per folder
settings.description: Choosing another layout in a folder, or Columns in it, is remembered for that folder. Going to a folder left in another layout turns Columns off for the tab, and going to a folder shown in Columns turns it on.

settings.name: Open a folder you hover on while dragging
settings.description: Holding dragged items on a folder row for about two thirds of a second opens the folder in the next column, so a drop can go deeper without letting go.

settings.name: Show a border after the last column
settings.description: The last column has no separator line on its right, so the columns end cleanly against the window. Switch it on to draw that line too.

settings.name: Shift and double-click a border to even the widths
settings.description: Holding Shift while double-clicking the border of a column sets every column to the average of the widths their names would fit. The widths then stay, as if dragged by hand, until a border is double-clicked on its own.

settings.name: Keep the columns after a file is chosen
settings.description: When a file, several items or nothing is chosen in a column, the columns to its right stay, dimmed, and come back when the folder is chosen again. Switch it off to close them instead.

settings.name: Drag items out of the panel
settings.description: Dragging rows past the edge of the panel starts a real drag, so they can be dropped on the desktop, in another window or in another application. Switch it off if rows should never leave the panel.

settings.name: Browse archives in columns
settings.description: A zip, 7z, rar or tar file opens as a folder in the next column, read by the shell's own archive support. Only on local fixed drives, and not above 512 MB. Archives that Windows cannot open as folders stay files.

settings.name: Keyboard on group headers
settings.description: Up from the first item of a group goes to its header, and Left, Right and Enter collapse and open it. Off, the arrow keys only move between items.

settings.name: Double-click on empty space goes up
settings.description: A double-click on the empty space of a column goes up one folder, as in the "Explorer double-click up" mod. In the first column the parent folder is added in front.

settings.name: Compact scrollbars
settings.description: Keeps the scrollbars of the columns thin, also when the pointer is over them. They can still be dragged and clicked.

settings.name: Show the focus outline on the active item
settings.description: The outline around the item under the keyboard cursor while you navigate with the arrow keys. Off hides it, the selection highlight stays.

settings.name: Panel background
settings.description: Explorer takes the colour of Explorer's own file list. Theme uses the standard dark or light colour. Transparent makes Explorer's own list invisible, not removed, and lets the window's own backdrop show through the panel. Test mode.

settings.name: Sidebar sets the first column
settings.description: A click on Home, Gallery, OneDrive or a pinned folder in the navigation pane makes that folder the first column. The expandable tree (This PC, drives, Network) keeps following the columns as before.

settings.name: Maximum column width
settings.description: Columns fit their longest name up to this width. Longer names are cut in the middle.

settings.name: Explorer follows the active column
settings.description: Explorer's own file list navigates to the folder of the column you are in, so the address bar, Back, the preview pane and the status bar stay in step.

settings.name: Write a debug log
settings.description: Writes to Code\windhawk-lib\probes\logs\explorer-extras.log in your user folder, if that folder exists.

settings.name: Show upcoming features in the settings window
settings.description: Adds the features that are planned and not built yet, Labels, Sidebar, Preview panel and Status bar, to the settings window as placeholder pages.

whatsNew: Extras in the View menu opens this window. Settings apply at once, and Reset goes back to Windhawk’s values.
Hold Shift and double-click a column border to give every column the same width.
Drag rows to another window, the desktop, the navigation pane or the tab strip. Hold them on a folder to open it.
Archives can be dragged out of, and a phone’s folders and OneDrive syncing show their own marks.
The toolbar’s Select all, Invert selection and Select none reach the columns.

strings.window.title: Explorer Extras
strings.home.title: Explorer Extras
strings.home.subtitle: Optional additions to File Explorer, each one with its own page and switch.
strings.tip.title: Tip
strings.tip.body: Choose Columns in the View menu of a File Explorer window. The Extras entry at the bottom of the ... menu on the toolbar opens this window.
strings.status.hooks.detail: The Explorer extension the mod hooks into.
strings.action.log.detail: The file the mod writes while it works, if its folder exists.
strings.action.copy.detail: Version, settings and state, as text, to paste in a message.
strings.action.reset.detail: Every setting goes back to what Windhawk’s page for the mod says.
strings.columns.title: Columns
strings.columns.subtitle: A Columns layout in the View menu: Miller columns drawn with Explorer’s own controls.
strings.columns.note: Changes apply at once. The mod keeps them in front of Windhawk’s page, and a later edit on that page for the same setting wins. Reset on the Explorer Extras page goes back to Windhawk’s values.
strings.soon.title: Coming soon
strings.soon.body: This feature is not built yet. Its switch and its settings will appear on this page when it is.
